established_incident_sequence: The scientific Experiment 2 execution completed successfully.
A full scientific result containing paired-divergence and per-seed data was observed after execution.
A later happy-path CLI unit test monkeypatched execute_assay.
The mocked execute_assay returned only schema, seeds, and conditions.
That test invoked main with --execute and no --output path.
The CLI therefore selected the canonical scientific result path.
The result writer used non-exclusive Path.write_text semantics.
The canonical artifact subsequently contained the same 199-byte stub structure produced by the mocked assay.
limitations: The original full result is not known to be recoverable from Git.
This incident record does not reconstruct missing scientific data.
A future deterministic reconstruction run requires separate prospective authorization.
